Author: SpecialAgentSkye
Name: SkyeMeter 2.0
Description: SkyeMeter connects to IINACT to display real-time DPS, HPS, and encounter statistics with a customizable ImGui interface. Features include pet damage merging, dual DPS/HPS tables, history tracking, and extensive visual customization. Additionally, we calculate the actual healing done, instead of merging healing and overhealing, for a REAL display of the healing done by each Combatant.
Punchline: A modern DPS meter overlay for FFXIV
Changelog:
- Connects to IINACT directly (IPC) — no more websocket setup needed. Websocket still available as fallback
- New: Damage Taken section, with its own breakdown (by ability and attacker). Can be detached into its own window
- New: Death recap — click a Deaths value to see the last moments before a death
- New: Target breakdown — filter any breakdown by target, with a draggable split
- New: Charts tab — DPS/HPS over time, crit/DH rates, damage composition, hit distribution
- New: Status effects tab — uptimes, applications and timelines for buffs/debuffs on a player
- New: Utility tab — interrupts, dispels, raises, mitigations and self-heals, with icons
- New: Compare mode — side-by-side ability comparison of two players
- New: (Experimental) DoT/HoT estimation — splits dot/hot ticks into named per-caster rows, off by default
- Estimated dot/hot rows are tagged (DoT)/(HoT) and can never exceed what ACT reports
- Pet abilities now group under a collapsible "(Pet)" bar in the breakdown
- New columns: Interrupts (DPS table) and Dispels (HPS table)
- Font size slider for different screen resolutions
- Overall entries now include target breakdowns, charts, status effects and deaths
- NPCs and chocobos now show their DPS in the rDPS column during combat instead of 0
- Meters clear instantly when a new pull starts instead of showing the previous pull
- Fixed encounter history sometimes failing to save (also made the history file smaller)
- Fixed Overall breakdowns showing 0 casts and broken averages
- Lots of internal cleanup
